name: doc-guardian
description: Manual Codex documentation checks backed by the existing Claude Code hook scripts.

interface.shortDescription: Check changelog, project guidance, and wiki sync manually.
interface.longDescription: Runs the existing documentation guardian checks on demand in Codex. Automatic Claude Code hook parity is not available — Codex receives neither PostToolUse nor Stop hooks, so the /doc-guardian skill invokes the same scripts by hand.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check whether this repository needs documentation or wiki updates.
